rules.title: One declared camera setup per shot
rules.statement: Every shot declares exactly one camera setup from the camera library vocabulary.

rules.title: Stay on one side of the line
rules.statement: A scene declares its line-of-action side; every shot in the scene declares the same side.

rules.title: Joins are continuous
rules.statement: At every chained join, the perceptual-hash distance between the previous take's true last frame and the next take's first frame stays within the calibrated threshold.

rules.title: Takes match the declared format
rules.statement: Every take decodes at the declared frame rate and resolution.

rules.title: Durations are feasible and sum to N
rules.statement: Shot count and per-shot planned durations sit inside the slot's window and sum exactly to the target seconds.

rules.title: Establish before you go close
rules.statement: The first shot at a new location is a wide or full setup before any close setup at that location, unless the shot declares an intentional override, which is recorded.

rules.title: Takes cover their planned seconds within budget
rules.statement: Each take measures at least its planned duration and overshoots by no more than its share of the timeline tolerance.

rules.title: The timeline lands on N
rules.statement: The assembled slice measures within the tolerance of the target seconds.

rules.title: No dead air
rules.statement: No take contains black or frozen segments beyond the calibrated fraction.

rules.title: Cut on action
rules.statement: A join lands inside a movement, not after it settles; stillness at a cut is a choice, never a default.

rules.title: Coverage earns its close-ups
rules.statement: A close setup pays off something the wider coverage set up; it is never the first acquaintance with a subject.
